chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Manchester, 2012: the last day of the season. City need a goal to win the league, and it is injury time. Sergio Agüero plays a one-two with Mario Balotelli... and scores! City are champions!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Agüero passes, and keeps running into the box. Balotelli, falling over, pokes it back into his path.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: One touch to control. He steps past the defender, and smashes it into the near corner. Ninety-three minutes and twenty seconds!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: never stop believing. A quick one-two in the box can win a match in the last minute!
